hypotheses.name: Persistent-homology null-sensitivity stress test
hypotheses.method: Ran iterations/iter_0005/run_iter0005_screen.py in subproject40-topology over lung/immune/external-lung with top+weak layers per domain, 3 seeds, 180 genes/test, PCA14, and two nulls (feature_shuffle n=20; distance_permutation n=4), then Fisher-combined p-values across seeds.
hypotheses.result_value: feature_shuffle: 8/12 significant (mean delta +3.998); distance_permutation: 0/12 significant (mean delta -850.942, 10/12 negative deltas)
hypotheses.next_action: Swap distance_permutation for a degree-preserving graph rewiring null and repeat the same evaluation grid.

hypotheses.name: Source/target disjoint split robustness of H1 signal
hypotheses.method: Within the same run, compared source_disjoint and target_disjoint split regimes for each domain-layer test under feature_shuffle null and required Fisher p<0.05 in both splits for robust pass.
hypotheses.result_value: 2/6 domain-layer combinations passed both splits (lung L0, external_lung L11); remaining 4/6 were split-sensitive
hypotheses.next_action: Increase split robustness coverage to all layers in immune and identify whether failures cluster by depth or domain.
